harper (People Ops): @here quick update for London folks — the building heating plant tripped overnight and we27re expecting reduced heat in the office Tues 2026-11-02. Facilities estimates repair window Tues 06:00 - Wed 18:00.

harper (People Ops): Short version: office open but temps may be low. If you27d prefer not to come in, you can work remotely or use one of the coworking fallbacks we booked. We27ll cover travel/transit costs and offer a small comfort stipend (details below).

leo (Facilities): Additional: heating may not reach target in meeting rooms and kitchen area. Hot water is available. Portable heaters are being brought in but capacity is limited 12 per floor. If you need a dedicated heater for medical reasons, DM me ASAP.

harper (People Ops): Coworking options (first-come):
- The Dock Cowork (Shoreditch) 1 desks reserved, 08:00-18:00
- Thameside Hub (London Bridge) 6 desks reserved, 09:00-17:00
- Quiet dayroom (for nursing parents / phone interviews) 1 room at The Dock, 08:00-18:00

harper (People Ops): Travel and stipend:
- If you normally commute in but prefer to go to a coworking fallback, we27ll cover travel up to A320 one-way (expense code london-heat-26).
- Comfort stipend: A35 for anyone who comes in and feels the office conditions were disruptive (claim with short note).
- If you need parking or taxi due to mobility, reply and we27ll approve case-by-case.

maya: I have a candidate onsite interview block at 10:00. Can we move to Zoom or the Thameside Hub?

harper (People Ops): @maya We can move to Thameside 10:00-11:30. Please DM names and we27ll reserve the room and provide passcodes. If you prefer remote, use company Zoom (we can create a Pro link).

isabel: Any change to mailroom or deliveries? I27m expecting equipment drop at 09:30.

leo (Facilities): @isabel Deliveries still accepted but large crates may be held at loading bay until heating restored. If you have time-sensitive gear, schedule an escorted pickup 08:00-09:00 Tues; fill the quick form: https://forms.company/escort-pickup.

alex: I27m on call Tues night and might need badge access to the server room. Is that affected?

leo (Facilities): @alex Server room on generator/UPS as usual. On-call badge access unchanged. If you need an escorted pass outside normal hours, submit a request by 16:00 Tues.

harper (People Ops): Food + comfort: we27ll set up a warming station near reception with tea/instant soup and extra blankets. Lunch catering may be cold boxes so plan accordingly. If you have dietary restrictions DM me.

maya: For the Thameside Hub, how do people get there from the office? Any shuttle?

harper (People Ops): No shuttle today, but here27s a quick walking/transit options snippet:
```
- Walk: 20-25 mins via Old St -> Shoreditch High St
- Bus 149 from Old St for 2 stops
- Dock to Thameside: 15min tube (Northern Line) + 5min walk
```

harper (People Ops): Please react with :white_check_mark: if you need a coworking desk / comfort stipend / escorted pickup / heater for medical reasons. We27ll triage tomorrow morning and send passcodes by 07:30.

calendar-bot: Event created: "London Office - Heating Repair (fallbacks arranged)" 2026-11-02 - 2026-11-03.

leo (Facilities): Facilities contact: Leo M. (ext 213). For urgent building issues call 020-555-0133 after hours.

harper (People Ops): Final note: if this affects candidate interviews or vendor visits longer-term, loop in People Ops and recruiting so we can reschedule. Thanks everyone 1

isabel: Thanks for the quick plan 1
